name: Grok 3

lifecycle.note: Retired from the xAI API; requests to grok-3 are served by grok-4.3.

replacedBy.note: grok-3 redirects to grok-4.3 with reasoning effort none.

released.note: The post says Grok 3 is now available to X Premium and Premium+ users on X and grok.com, as a beta; it also says the rollout to users would take place over the coming days.

retired.note: Effective 12:00 PM PT on the xAI API.

milestones.label: Generally available on the xAI API

sources.locator: Our path of progress, 2025: Grok 3 API

relations.note: Editorial link along the main Grok line: the announcement names no predecessor model, and the December 2024 Grok-2 was the current flagship before it.

summary.text: Grok 3 is a language model from xAI with a reasoning mode, Grok 3 (Think). It launched as a beta on 19 February 2025 for X Premium and Premium+ users on X and grok.com, became generally available on the xAI API on 3 April 2025 and was retired from the API on 15 May 2026. xAI says it was trained on its Colossus supercluster.

changes.text: Context window of 1 million tokens, which xAI called eight times larger than its previous models; the grok-3 API model page listed 131,072 tokens.
Adds a beta reasoning mode, Grok 3 (Think), trained with large-scale reinforcement learning to think for seconds to minutes before answering.

sources.locator: Thinking Harder: Test-time Compute and Reasoning

changes.text: xAI says it trained Grok 3 on its Colossus supercluster with ten times the compute of earlier leading models.
Launched together with DeepSearch, an xAI agent that searches for information and writes a summary report.

inputModalities.note: As listed for the API model grok-3 (drawn as icons: text to text). The announcement also reports image and video understanding evaluations, which are not reflected here.

sources.locator: Thinking Harder: Test-time Compute and Reasoning

features.note: Grok 3 (Think), a beta reasoning mode at launch, switched on with the Think button.

contextWindowTokens.note: The xAI API model page listed a context window of 131,072 tokens for grok-3 (src.xai.grok-3-api-model-page).

notes: Launched as Grok 3 Beta. Grok 3 (Think) is the name of its reasoning mode in the announcement; the Grok 4 announcement calls it Grok 3 Reasoning. Both kept as aliases. Lifecycle and retirement apply to the xAI API (May 15, 2026 retirement guide); no source states when Grok 3 left the consumer apps. No deprecation notice date is given, so deprecated is left empty. Context window: the announcement gives 1 million tokens, the API model page 131,072. Image input is not recorded because the API model page lists text only. No model card for Grok 3 was found. grok-3-fast was a separate faster-serving API listing linked from the grok-3 model page, kept as a candidate alias.
